senses.gloss:
खिद् खिद॑ति pp. खिन्न (q.v.) depress (fig.);
 P.
खिद्यते (˚ति) be depressed, languish, suffer pain. C. खेदयति,
˚ते depress, afflict, vex. —आ snatch. उद् pull out. नि press
down. निस् cut off, remove. परि P. = S. P. प्र push away. वि
tear asunder. सम् press together;
 pull out, snatch away. — Cf.
परिखिन्न.
खिद्र॑ n. a borer or hammer.
